name: Touhou Tougensai
detailed_description:
High above the skies, in the celestial paradise of Tenkai, Hinanawi Tenshi lives a carefree existence, free from hardship or struggle. But with no challenges to overcome, life has become unbearably dull. The only thing that keeps this paradise running is its boundless supply of peaches, a vital source of sustenance and power for all celestials.

One day, disaster strikes—the Primordial Peach, the fruit from which all others sprout, vanishes without a trace. In an instant, the stability of Tenkai is thrown into question. With no peaches, the once-blissful paradise faces uncertainty, and to Tenshi, this is the most infuriating disruption imaginable. Just as she prepares to set out in search of answers, strange rumors begin to spread—peaches, eerily similar to those from Tenkai , have started appearing all across Gensokyo.

But something is off. Those who consume these mysterious fruits are undergoing bizarre transformations, their powers fluctuating wildly, their very beings mutating in ways unknown. Someone—or something—has taken the Primordial Peach and scattered its influence across the land. Furious and eager for action, Tenshi sets off on a journey through Gensokyo, determined to uncover the truth and reclaim what was stolen.

With each step forward, she clashes with those who stand in her way, unleashing her celestial strength upon anyone—human, youkai, or even fellow celestials—who dares to oppose her. She will not stop until the Primordial Peach is reclaimed, and ordinary life has restored!

1. Gameplay

Tenshi isn’t here to talk—she’s here to beat up everything in sight. In this fast-paced beat ‘em up, she plows through relentless waves of enemies, smashing them with her sword, shaking the earth with powerful quakes, and unleashing flashy combos. If they stand in her way, they’re getting wrecked—no exceptions.

2. Levels

Tenshi’s journey takes her through Gensokyo’s many landscapes, starting from the celestial paradise of Tenkai , where golden clouds stretch endlessly and peaches once flourished in abundance. Now, with the Primordial Peach missing, the skies feel eerily empty, and paradise itself seems out of balance.

Descending to the earth below, she arrives at Misty Lake, now swallowed in a thick, unnatural fog. Its once-clear waters are littered with glowing peaches, and those who consume them are mutating into something… different. Beyond the lake, ancient forests hum with strange energy, sacred shrines stand in unsettling silence, and distant mountains tremble as if disturbed by an unseen force. Something has warped the land, and its effects are spreading fast.

short_description: Touhou Tougensai is a fast-paced beat‘em up game set in the world of Gensokyo. The peaceful yet boring life of Tenkai has suddenly been disrupted; the Primordial Peach, the Peach of All Peaches, has disappeared! Enraged, Tenshi will brutally trample over everything and everyone to reclaim it.
